title: WPMS/2254/2015 of M/s Nature Quest India Pvt Ltd Vs State Of Uttarakhand AND OTHERS

paras.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF UTTARAKHAND AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 2254 of 2015 (M/S)
M/s Nature Quest (India) Pvt. Ltd. ............. Petitioner
 versus
State of Uttarakhand & others ............. Respondents
Mr. Rajendra Dobhal, Sr. Advocate assisted by Mr. Devang Dobhal,
Advocate for the petitioner.
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Standing Counsel for the State / respondents.
U.C. Dhyani, J. (oral)

By means of present writ petition, the petitioner
seeks to issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of
mandamus directing respondent no. 3 to correct the revenue
records of the plots, which were subject matter of the
orders under challenge, and incorporate the name of
petitioner in the aforesaid plots after deleting the name of
the State Government.
2) Heard learned counsel for the parties and
perused the documents brought on record, including the
judgment and order dated 08.05.2009, passed by learned
Addl. Chief Revenue Commissioner, Uttarakhand,
Dehradun, in Civil Revision no. 59 of 2002-03, titled as
M/s Nature Quest (India) Pvt. Ltd. vs State of Uttarakhand
and others.
3) The aforesaid order has attained finality, as per
the statement of learned Senior Counsel representing the
writ petitioner.

2
4) It will be useful to reproduce paragraph nos. 9
and 14 of the writ petition. The same reads as under:
"It is stated here that the D.G.C. (Revenue),
Dehradun vide his letter dated 14.10.2010 has also
intimated to the Assistant Collector, Ist Class, Vikas
Nagar, District Dehradun that against the judgment and
order dated 08.05.2009, passed by Addl. Chief Revenue
Commissioner, Uttarakhand, Dehradun, no appeal or writ
petition is pending before the court.
 The judgment and order dated 08.05.2009, passed
by Addl. Chief Revenue Commissioner, Uttarakhand,
Dehradun, has became final and after the said order the
petitioner is legally entitled to get its name recorded in
the revenue records over the plots which were subject
matter of the order dated 29.05.2000, passed by the Asstt.
Collector, Ist Class, Vikas Nagar, District Dehradun after
deleting the name of the State Government."
5) Annexure no. 6, which is a letter dated
14.10.2010 written by DGC (Revenue), Dehradun to the
Asstt. Collector, Ist Class, Vikas Nagar, Dehradun, says
that no appeal or writ petition has been filed against the
order dated 08.05.2009, passed by learned Addl. Chief
Revenue Commissioner, which has set aside the judgment
dated 29.05.2000, passed by Asstt. Collector, Ist Class,
Vikasnagar, Dehradun in Revenue Suit no. 05 of 1998-99,
State vs Nature Quest (India) Pvt. Ltd. Vide order dated
29.05.2000, Asstt. Collector, Ist Class, Vikas Nagar
directed that the suit property shall vest in the State of U.P.
(now Uttarakhand), which order has been set aside by
learned Addl. Chief Revenue Commissioner vide order

3
dated 08.05.2009. Learned Senior Counsel representing the
writ petition only seeks to enforce order dated 08.05.2009,
passed by learned Addl. Chief Revenue Commissioner.
6) Learned counsel representing State submitted
that liberty may be granted to the State to move recall
application, in case, order dated 08.05.2009 is challenged
or set aside by the competent courts. Such liberty should
be granted to the State while disposing of the present writ
petition at the admission stage itself.
7) Writ petition is allowed. Respondent no. 3 is
directed to correct the revenue records of khatas nos. 33, 48
and 166, complete description of which has been given in
the prayer clause of the writ petition, as per law.
8) Liberty is, however, granted to the respondent
State to move for recall of this order, in case, the order
dated 08.05.2009, passed by learned Addl. Chief Revenue
Commissioner is set aside by any competent court.
